head: Bitdefender Web Sage: a browser extension that flags scam sites
dek: Bitdefender launched Web Sage, a browser extension for Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari and Brave that checks each page you open against its threat data and warns about scams.
details: It works in the background without setup. Paid features add AI analysis of a page's behavior and content. In Bitdefender's survey of 7,000 people, one in seven said they fell for an online scam in the last 12 months, and 21% of those were scammed through an online ad.
where: Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari and Brave
means: You get a warning before you type card details into a fake shop or phishing page.
todo: Install Web Sage from your browser's extension store; keep using the browser's own scam warnings too.
